text.description_html:
Don-Jo 7015-613, Oil Rubbed Bronze 3-1/2 x 15 Pull Plate

Common size 3-1/2" x 15" door pull plate with 6" round pull handle. Primarily used in restaurants, warehouses, factories and stores. Made of .050" thick brass. Oil Rubbed Bronze finish. Packaged with matching mounting hardware for easy installation.

Specifications of the Don-Jo 7015-613 Oil Rubbed Bronze Pull Plate:

  • Plate Height: 15"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 3/4"
  • Pull Handle Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Pull Handle Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Center to Center (CTC): 6"
  • Total Pull Length: 6-3/4"
  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws

*Sold Individually.
